plainTranslation: Person A (Venus)'s affection and enjoyment can elicit generosity and goodwill from the Person B (Jupiter) person. Person B (Jupiter)'s appreciation of Person A (Venus)'s tastes or creative expression can make affection easier to express; Person A (Venus)'s warm response can make Person B (Jupiter) feel that the offered encouragement is valued. Their social interests and ways of enjoying themselves may complement each other, with mutual admiration contributing to the appeal of spending time together. The sextile describes a cooperative possibility that the people can engage with, rather than a guaranteed relationship outcome. It does not require a problem about complacency or prove that one person will always provide more than the other.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant work smoothly with your judgment about what's possible. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: That's the catch with this one. The warmth opens the door and then just stands there. Coast on it, assume it runs itself, and you end up with a great connection you never actually used.
advice: So treat it like anything good. Show up for it. The more you put in, the more this person becomes someone you can count on, instead of a nice thing you let slip.
